name: qa-pilot
description: QA copilot for existing projects with three commands: onboard (set up the project profile), test (per-task QA: a plan before coding; verification, impact analysis and missing tests after; exploratory browser testing on request) and audit (the big picture: whole project, a feature's requirements against a 1100+ rule catalog and verified own rules, the test code, or a UI component library bottom-up). Strict quality gates and token economy for subscription plans.
